findings.claim: On pickup tracks, setPowerUp(true) runs panel.insertBefore(powerUp, pause) on every frame, even when the node is already in place. So every race-UI sync on Dust Bowl removes and re-inserts a DOM node. That breaks race-ui.ts's documented contract that a frame where nothing changed touches no DOM.
findings.evidence: race-ui.ts:151 calls `legend.setPowerUp(view.pickups !== undefined);` unconditionally on every sync. keycap-legend.ts:63-65: `setPowerUp(on) { if (on) panel.insertBefore(powerUp, pause); else powerUp.remove(); }`. There is no early return when the state is unchanged. Under the DOM spec, insertBefore of a node that is already a child first removes it and then inserts it, which produces childList mutation records. Repro: copy tests/ui/race-ui.test.ts 'touches no DOM when a frame changes nothing' but use `const frame = view({ raceTick: 600, pickups: [true] })`. Call ui.sync(frame, cars) twice with a MutationObserver on document.body, then check `obs.takeRecords()`. It is non-empty, where the existing contract expects 0. This happens every rendered frame for the whole Dust Bowl race, including laps 2+ when the legend is hidden.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep the current state and return early, the same way touch-controls' setAction does: `let powerUpOn = false; … setPowerUp(on) { if (on === powerUpOn) return; powerUpOn = on; if (on) panel.insertBefore(powerUp, pause); else powerUp.remove(); }`.

checked.how: Compared both images. The ⌀64 roundel sits centred above GAS with about a 12px gap, as in the mockup. Unarmed is a dirt fill with a dark-dirt bolt, ink ring and 4px ink shadow, matching the mockup's action button. Armed is mustard with an ink bolt, per §1 (mustard = pickups) and the audit's pinned states.
The keycap legend reads STEER, GAS, BRAKE, SPACE · POWER-UP, PAUSE in the mockup's order. The SPACE keycap is mustard with ink text, as in the mockup. No touch controls show on desktop.

Dust Bowl shows the action button. In the 1440 start frame the pickup boxes are small mustard cubes with dirt sides, ink outlines and ink blob shadows on the dirt, visibly smaller than the bales. I didn't see glow or other new colours.

Only var(--…) tokens are used (--touch-action 64px, --radius-round 50%, --color-dirt/dark-dirt/mustard/ink, --space-s3). No literals, opacity, gradients or filters. .is-resting (0,2,0, later in the file) still wins over .ui-tc--action.is-armed, so resting stays hollow. The pop reuses the ui-tc-wake keyframes (transform plus shadow) and is cut under reduced motion. Colours cut and never tween.
`.ui-keycap--pickup` uses var(--space-s4), var(--color-mustard) and var(--color-ink). Ink on mustard is an allowed pairing (§2).
The bolt is a solid filled polygon, not a thin-line icon (§11). The aria-label is 'Boost', as AC8 requires. Legend text is 'SPACE' / 'POWER-UP', matching the mockup's case and hyphen.

The mesh uses palette name 'mustard' via MeshBuilder.box. The shadow is a ground 'ink' blob. Materials come from the createMaterials factory (mats), with no new material construction. Hidden boxes use .visible, not opacity.

checked.target: Per-frame DOM churn in race-ui sync
checked.how: Read tests/ui/race-ui.test.ts:63 (the no-DOM-touch contract). Grepped insertBefore/setPowerUp: the call is unconditional at race-ui.ts:151 with no guard at keycap-legend.ts:64. That gave F1. setAction in touch-controls.ts does guard with `if (next === armed) return`.
